title: [BUG] Claude Pro users are not currently able to use Opus in Claude Code
body:
- Platform (select one):
    - Anthropic API
    - AWS Bedrock
    - Google Vertex AI
    - Other:
  - Claude CLI version: 1.0.81 (Claude Code)
  - Operating System: Linux 6.6.87.2-microsoft-standard-WSL2
  - Terminal: WSL2

  Bug Description

  Claude Pro users receive an error when attempting to use Opus model despite official documentation stating it should be available.

  Steps to Reproduce

  1. Log in as a Claude Pro user
  2. Run /model Opus or /model Opus 4.1 command in Claude Code
  3. Observe error message

  Expected Behavior

  Claude Pro users should be able to access Opus 4.1 as stated on the official Anthropic website at https://www.anthropic.com/claude/opus which explicitly lists "available on
  Claude for Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise users" and mentions availability "in Claude Code".

  Actual Behavior

  Error message: "Invalid model. Claude Pro users are not currently able to use Opus in Claude Code. The current model is now Sonnet."

  Additional Context

  There appears to be a discrepancy between the published capabilities on the Anthropic website and the actual implementation in Claude Code. The error message specifically
  mentions Pro users cannot access Opus, which contradicts the official documentation.
author: JasonDevloo
